appearance_facts.fact: Title: 'Positive Test Rate at Sentinel Sites'.
Subtitle: 'Reported window shown in the dashboard summary'.
Y-axis labeled 'Positive test rate' with gridlines and tick marks at 5.5%, 6.0%, 6.5%, 7.0%, 7.5%, and 8.0%.
X-axis labeled 'Year' with tick marks for 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020.
A single purple line connects four data points, one for each year from 2017 to 2020.
The data point for 2017 is at approximately 5.5% on the y-axis.
The data point for 2018 is at approximately 6.5% on the y-axis.
The data point for 2019 is at approximately 7.2% on the y-axis.

public_definitions: The task is to review the trend dashboard and select the operational route that best reflects the full 2013-2020 pattern for positive test rate.
The dashboard displays only data from 2017 to 2020, not the full 2013-2020 period.

The three routing options are: 'Route to continued monitoring for a more recent upward shift', 'Route to sustained growth follow-up for an across-period increase', and 'Route to decline-focused review for a downward pattern'.
uncertain: The chart does not display data for the years 2013-2016, so the full 2013-2020 pattern cannot be assessed from this visualization.
